2. **`pthm-cm12-hamilton-equivalence`** — Cartesian-chart notation in clauses 1(b)/2(b) and steps 1.1/2.2: `$H_{q}$` → `$H_{x}$` for the second slot of $H(t,x,p)$ (it clashed with the chart symbol $q$ used in the same statement and with the companion examples' $H_{x}$ usage). The supplier's generic identities in [F4] and the genuine $\widetilde H_{q}$ chart clauses are untouched.
